definitions.gloss: to nod; to nod in agreement
definitions.explanation: To move one's head up and down to indicate agreement, understanding, or acknowledgment.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{静|しず}かに{頷|うなず}いた。
{説明|せつめい}を{聞|き}きながら{頷|うなず}く。
examples.english: To nod while listening to an explanation.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{意見|いけん}に{深|ふか}く{頷|うなず}いた。
examples.english: I nodded deeply in agreement with her opinion.

notes:
{頷|うなず}く specifically refers to the head-nodding motion that indicates agreement or acknowledgment.

CONJUGATION (godan verb):
- {頷|うなず}く (dictionary form)
- {頷|うなず}かない (negative)
- {頷|うなず}いた (past)
- {頷|うなず}いて (te-form)

KANJI NOTE:
Often written in hiragana as うなずく or with okurigana as {頷|うなづ}く.

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {首|くび}を{縦|たて}に{振|ふ}る: to nod (literally "shake head vertically")
- {首|くび}を{横|よこ}に{振|ふ}る: to shake head (to indicate "no")
